scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
benefits_summary: One-year renewable term life insurance cover of ₹2,00,000 for death due to any reason at an annual premium of ₹436.
exclusions: New enrollees above 50 years of age
application_steps: Visit your savings bank branch or net banking portal.
Submit the PMJJBY enrollment cum auto-debit mandate form.
Ensure sufficient balance for the ₹436 annual premium deduction.
